The Finance Team at Lybover is responsible for managing the company's financial health by overseeing budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting. They ensure compliance with financial regulations while optimizing resource allocation across various engineering projects. Additionally, the team plays a crucial role in payroll management and employee compensation, supporting the overall well-being of the company’s workforce.

New partnership for Belgium and Luxembourg 
##  Westeria & Lybover join forces 
With Lybover, Westeria now has a strong partner at its side who is responsible for sales and service of Westeria technologies, such as windsifters, dosing bunkers, DiscSpreader and the entire portfolio of conveying technology. 
Together with Lybover, Westeria is significantly expanding its business activities and customer support in Belgium and Luxembourg.
Belgium is an important market for Westeria. Lybover, founded in 1985 as a family-run extraction and filtration company in Belgium, today offers six business areas, each with its own expertise in the international market. With more than 200 employees and 5000 completed projects, Lybover stands for dynamic development and a long-term fruitful partnership – goals and values that unite both companies.
Lybover's customer base and expertise are an excellent fit for Westeria. "Through this collaboration, we are significantly strengthening our presence in the market and our proximity to customers. We are pleased to bring together the strengths of both companies to better provide our innovative solutions to customers in Belgium and Luxembourg in the future with Lybover as our sales and service partner" says Rainer Flaute, Head of Sales at Westeria.

## Een succesformule op jouw maat
![](https://www.lybover.be/wp-content/themes/lybover21/assets/img/icon-complex.svg)
### Hoe complexer, hoe liever
Wij houden van installaties die volledig aan jouw noden voldoen. Complex project? Challenge accepted!
![](https://www.lybover.be/wp-content/themes/lybover21/assets/img/icon-one-place.svg)
### Je project onder één dak
We nemen het volledige engineering proces in eigen handen. Zo hoef je je nooit zorgen te maken om verschillende leveranciers samen te brengen.  
Je project verloopt gestroomlijnd – van initiële prijsafspraak en advies tot dienst na verkoop.
![](https://www.lybover.be/wp-content/themes/lybover21/assets/img/icon-experts.svg)
### Experts met brede blik
Onze engineers zijn dé autoriteit in hun domein dankzij hun uitgebreide training en jarenlange expertise. En nog liever kijken ze over muurtjes heen en werken ze samen met hun collega’s aan grensoverschrijdende projecten.

# Turning visions into projects
Lybover gives you the best quality. How? Well, according to our own way of working. So you don’t have to worry about a thing. 
![](https://www.lybover.be/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/lybover3_WAL0205_1500_min.jpg)
#### Your project under one roof
Lybover works according to a proven method in which we take the entire engineering process in our own hands. Entirely tailored to your needs.
This way you don’t have to bring together multiple suppliers. We make sure that your project runs smoothly. From A to Z. From initial price request and advice to after-sales services. 
#### The more complex,  
the better
We love challenges. First, we really get stuck in and then we let ourselves go. As a dedicated expert Lybover stands for a dynamic and trustworthy long-term partnership. 
Complex project? Challenge accepted! Based on our flexible hands-on method we gladly make the difference for you. For short and long-term added value.
![](https://www.lybover.be/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Lybover4MW1_6989_1500_min.jpg)
![](https://www.lybover.be/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/Lybover4_WAL2207_1500_min.jpg)
#### Experts  
with a broad perspective
Our engineers, designers, mechanics… each of them expert in their own field. Thanks to their extended training and often years of expertise, but also through working together day in day out and making each other better. 
The result? Solutions and installations which are built with your requirements in mind.
![Video placeholder](https://www.lybover.be/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/placeholder.jpg)
<https://www.lybover.be/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Corporate-presentation-EN-blanco.mp4>
#### Working at Lybover is…
### working on exciting projects:
At Lybover we don’t build piecework. No, with us you have to bring out all your know-how, because our customers expect and demand complex installations. And everyone has a contribution to make. Everything to bring the project to a good end.
### a lot of freedom and responsibility:
As every project at Lybover is different, we give you enough freedom to think up or execute the appropriate solution – together with your team.
### yet still a family atmosphere:
We believe it is extremely important to continue to grow nationally and internationally. But this should not be at the expense of the family atmosphere that prevails within our company. Within our teams, there is a no-nonsense mentality, just because we can trust each other so well.
[Check out our vacancies](https://www.lybover.be/nl/jobs/)
## Hands-on since 1985
What’s in a name? The founders of the company in this case. Luc & Yvette Boels-Vermeulen. Despite the international presence and the large group of employees, the familial atmosphere from Lybover that we treasure remains intact. Their sons, Hans and Filip Boels, still lead the way as CEO’s of the company. Today, Lybover’s five business units provide answers to the most diverse challenges. Each with their own expertise, but through and through Lybover. An overview of our companies and business units can be found [here](https://lybover.be/_files/Vennootschapsstructuur_A4_EN.pdf).
1985
### The start of the Lybover-story
Luc Boels starts as an independent agent for Keller Lufttechnik GmbH. In 1993 he takes over the French subsidiary. The focus lies on solutions for industrial dust extraction (AIR).
1995-1997 
### The first expansion 
Start-up of Hafibo Assembly (1995) and Hafibo Construction (1997). The foundations for Lybover METAL have been laid.
2005
### The forerunner of BULK
In 2005 Lybover becomes an agent of Maschinenfabrik Gustav Eirich GmbH & Co KG, world leader in mixing technologies.
2006 
### A new step forward
Our air technology know-how is put to use in the search for solutions for smoke and heat extraction in car parks. The foundation for Lybover FIRE. 
2009
### The takeover of BULK .ID
The acquisition of BULK .ID in 2009 marks the start of Lybover RECYCLING.
2014 
### The growth continues
Motogroup (BULK) is acquired. Meanwhile, AIR launches in the UK. 
2017
### Centralisation of the assembly activities
All assembly activities are centralised (INSTALLATION). 
2018
### Introduction of the Lybover group structure
All the knowledge to make your engineering project a success under one roof.   
  
AIR (Keller Lufttechnik Benelux – Keller France – Luksal), METAL (Hafibo), FIRE (Keller Benelux), RECYCLING (BULK.ID), BULK (Motogroup), INSTALLATION (Lybotech)
2024
### Lybover FIRE becomes Altebra Waregem
Lybover will remain active in the construction industry through participation in Altebra and will work even more intensively in the industrial market through its other Business Units, which remain 100% Lybover.

##  The Lybover Way

#  Lybover ![](https://www.impress.be/img/h1-arrow.png)
"Voor onze binnen- en buitensignalisatie zochten we een partner die niet alleen functioneel kon meedenken, maar ook esthetisch kon aansluiten bij onze bestaande architectuur en materialen. Impress bleek daarin een goede match. Vanaf het eerste contact was duidelijk dat Impress onze visie begreep: signalisatie moet niet alleen duidelijk en gebruiksvriendelijk zijn, maar ook naadloos aansluiten bij de uitstraling van het gebouw en de omgeving. Het resultaat is een modern en tijdloos ontwerp dat perfect past bij onze bestaande materialen en kleurenpalet. Zowel binnen als buiten vormen de elementen één coherent geheel, zonder in te boeten aan leesbaarheid of functionaliteit."
